title: senro attach frame
description: One message on the attach socket's control channel: a client-initiated request and the server's correlated response. JSON so the protocol is debuggable with websocat; only per-step log chunks use a binary channel. This schema is CLOSED (additionalProperties is false): a frame is point-to-point between an engine and a client that negotiated a version on the handshake, so both ends know the frame shape in use. Events, by contrast, are persisted to events.jsonl and re-read later by readers that never handshook with the writer, which is why their envelope stays open (see event.schema.json), and the lifecycle stream itself is not frame-wrapped at all: GET /api/stream emits bare events, and its own end-of-stream signal is stream_end.schema.json, not a frame kind here.

kind.description: req is a client-initiated control operation; res is the server's response, correlated by id.

id.description: Correlation ID; required on req and its matching res.

error.description: Failure reason; res only, when ok is false.
